cranium_note: Affine fit of the source cranium to the untouched regions of skull 28/29 (from mechanical/revisions/b26/assembly-review.json skull_study.scan_registration). Cropped to |x| >= 22 mm and z <= 186 mm, capped, decimated (max deviation 0.05 mm).
mandible_note: Source mandible moved by the cranium fit, then a similarity fit (scale 1.040) to the body of jaw 30 at the closed pose (60% trimmed ICP, median 1.44 mm). Decimated (q99 deviation below 0.05 mm). Jaw frame = world frame at jaw 0 deg.
